```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: Path to agent markdown files
        required: false
        default: .continue/agents
        type: string

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.list.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq
        shell: bash

      - name: Find agent files
        id: list
        run: |
          echo "Searching for .md agents in ${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          AGENTS=$(find "${{ inputs.agents-path }}" -type f -name '*.md' -printf '%p\n' | jq -R . | jq -s .)
          echo "agents=$AGENTS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

  run-agents:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover.outputs.agents) }}
      fail-fast: false
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      AGENT_PATH: ${{ matrix.agent }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: npm install -g @continue/cli
        shell: bash

      - name: Run agent
        id: run
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          AGENT_PATH: ${{ matrix.agent }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          OUTPUT=$(continue run "$AGENT_PATH" 2>&1)
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          echo "output=$OUTPUT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "exit_code=$EXIT_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          exit $EXIT_CODE
        shell: bash

      - name: Create check run
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          AGENT_PATH: ${{ matrix.agent }}
          AGENT_OUTPUT: ${{ steps.run.outputs.output }}
          CONCLUSION: ${{ steps.run.outcome }}
        with:
          script: |
            const agentPath = process.env.AGENT_PATH;
            const output = process.env.AGENT_OUTPUT;
            const conclusion = process.env.CONCLUSION === 'success' ? 'success' : 'failure';
            await github.rest.checks.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${agentPath}`,
              head_sha: context.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: conclusion,
              output: {
                title: `Continue Agent: ${agentPath}`,
                summary: output,
                text: output
              }
            });
        if: always()

      - name: Fail job if agent failed
        if: steps.run.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: exit 1
        shell: bash

      - name: Append to job summary
        if: always()
        env:
          AGENT_PATH: ${{ matrix.agent }}
          AGENT_OUTPUT: ${{ steps.run.outputs.output }}
        run: |
          echo "## Agent: $AGENT_PATH" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Output" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "$AGENT_OUTPUT" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        shell: bash
